item.title: Trump predicted Israel-Lebanon leaders would speak ‘tomorrow’ — Beirut shut it down as ceasefire emerges
item.summary: Lebanon's President Aoun will not speak with Netanyahu for now, a senior Lebanese official told Fox News Digital, dealing a setback to Trump's push for direct contact with Israel.

item.title: Iran to execute first female protester tied to anti-regime unrest
item.summary: Iran prepares to execute its first female protester tied to the 2026 Tehran uprising as human rights groups warn of a deepening crackdown.

item.title: Allies rush thousands of drones to Ukraine as Russia unleashes deadly missile barrages
item.summary: Ukraine's allies pledge massive military aid, including 120,000 U.K. drones, as Russia launches 324 drones and ballistic missiles, officials report.

item.title: Iran shifts 20M barrels through ‘dark’ offshore oil network bypassing US port blockade, firm says
item.summary: Iran is moving roughly 20 million barrels of oil through covert offshore networks near Malaysia to bypass the U.S. blockade, Windward AI says.

item.title: Israeli strike on Hezbollah more devastating than 2024 pager attack, IDF says
item.summary: Israel says roughly 50 aircraft struck more than 100 Hezbollah targets across Lebanon in a devastating 60-second operation that killed 250 operatives.

item.title: From Auschwitz, Holocaust survivor issues urgent warning over rising antisemitism in Canada
item.summary: Holocaust survivor Nate Leipciger, 98, warns from Auschwitz about growing antisemitism in Canada, calling on the nation to stand up and take action now.

item.title: Iran threatens to halt Red Sea traffic in response to US military blockade of ports
item.summary: Iran's military warns it could block exports and imports in the Red Sea, Persian Gulf and Sea of Oman if the U.S. blockade of Iranian ports is not lifted.

item.title: Russia's Lavrov says Iran has 'inalienable' right to enrich uranium, openly defying Trump's demands
item.summary: Russia's Sergey Lavrov says Iran has an inalienable right to enrich uranium for civilian purposes, pushing back against Trump's nuclear demands.

item.title: Starmer and Macron accused of ‘playing at being relevant’ with Strait of Hormuz plan
item.summary: Britain and France push a European-led naval mission to safeguard shipping in the Strait of Hormuz, separate from U.S. military operations in the region.

item.title: Russian missiles and drones bombard Ukraine in hourslong attack, killing at least 16
item.summary: Russia launched nearly 700 drones and dozens of missiles at Ukraine, killing at least 16 people and injuring over 80 in its biggest attack in weeks.
